messages:
zoe.marketing: Hey @raj.runtime quick ask — can you run a very small sanity sweep to validate the launch bench numbers for the Summit post? We just need a fast check (10-50 real-ish samples) across quantized int8 vs fp16, plus a warmup profile and a coldstart probe. Goal: confirm p99 and coldstart delta that marketing quoted.

zoe.marketing: Rough specs: use anonymized prod-sampled payloads (I attached payloads/launch_cohort_2026.json). Target routes: /generate (chat), /embed. Please include token-cost breakdown per route.

zoe.marketing: Quick command idea for runtime:```bash
bench-run --model redwood-1-15B-q8 --payload payloads/launch_cohort_2026.json --warmup 100 --concurrency 8 --duration 1h --trace --tag campaign:summit_launch
```

raj.runtime: We can do a mini-sweep tomorrow morning. Q: are the payloads full prod examples or synthetic short-cases? Also what's the acceptance thresholds so we know if results are surprising?

zoe.marketing: payloads are prod-ish (anonymized), mix of short+long contexts. Acceptance: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms on hosted/dedicated baseline; coldstart delta <= 3x typical steady-state. If anything is outside that, flag it.

mia.eng: Please tag runs with campaign=summit and seed=42. Also add a canary route so traffic isolation is trivial. If you can capture traces, include kv-cache hit rates.

ben.ops: I'll reserve two g5-type nodes for the sweep and set up a short-lived dedicated pool. ETA to start ~06:00 UTC tomorrow. Expect artifacts (csv + traces) posted to /artifacts/infra/5345678901 within ~2h after run completes.

raj.runtime: scheduling 06:00 UTC. We'll run both q8 and fp16 variants and a quick coldstart-only pass (empty cache start). I'll post raw CSV + percentile breakdown + coldstart heatmap. I'll also run a tiny embed-only sweep to compare cost-per-embed.

ci-bot: Created INF-4021 (mini-bench: summit_launch sanity sweep) and linked to campaign=summit_launch.

zoe.marketing: Amazing, thx. One more ask — include per-route token-cost and a tiny note on variability (stdev of p99 across runs). If warmup significantly moves numbers, mark the warmup used. :pray:

raj.runtime: Got it — we'll include warmup details, per-route cost, and a variability table. Posting results in thread when ready.

zoe.marketing: Appreciate it — this will go into the launch bench appendix for the blog.

ben.ops: FYI — saved the reserved capacity as ephemeral; will auto-clean after 4h.

raj.runtime: Kicking off run now (starting warmup). Will update with run id and artifacts link.

raj.runtime: Run complete. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/reports/INF-4021/sweep-results.csv and traces at https://artifacts.internal/reports/INF-4021/traces.zip. Summary in next message.

raj.runtime: Quick summary: q8 steady-state p95=110ms p99=320ms, fp16 steady-state p95=95ms p99=270ms. Coldstart delta (q8)=3.4x, (fp16)=2.8x. Variability: p99 stdev across three repeats ~12ms. Per-route embed cost ~0.0009 USD/token (q8) vs 0.0011 (fp16) — see CSV for detail.

zoe.marketing: This is perfect — passing for our claims but will note q8 coldstart slightly above our 3x threshold, will add caveat. Thanks all!

mia.eng: I'll open a quick follow-up to investigate q8 coldstart path; might be a cache priming gap.

ci-bot: Linked INF-4021 -> ENG-789 (q8-coldstart-investigation).

zoe.marketing: Closing the loop here. Pls ping if any follow-ups. :tada:
